summary: Iteration 3 frontend-only testing for AussieBack Share Card + WhatsApp Live Chat features. All 5 requested items verified end-to-end via Playwright against the public preview URL. Backend was restarted first to clear slowapi rate limit. Regression sanity on admin login + leads dashboard also passes.
verified_features: WhatsApp float button [data-testid='whatsapp-float'] renders bottom-right with href=https://wa.me/61400000000?text=Hi%20AussieBack!... and target=_blank (correct env stripping of '+').

Inactivity nudge [data-testid='whatsapp-nudge'] auto-appears after ~20s idle with title 'Still there? 👋'; CTA [data-testid='whatsapp-nudge-cta'] shares same wa.me href; dismiss [data-testid='whatsapp-nudge-dismiss'] removes bubble and prevents re-appearance (dismissed state).
Estimator 3-step flow submits with +61412345678 -> submitted-state renders both [data-testid='share-estimate-btn'] and [data-testid='restart-estimator'].

Share modal [data-testid='share-card-modal'] opens; canvas-rendered preview [data-testid='share-card-preview'] mounts as data:image/png data URL; three action buttons visible (share-download, share-native, share-copy); copy-link writes to clipboard and 'Link copied!' toast appears.
Regression: Admin login (admin@aussieback.com / Admin@123) works, lead pipeline dashboard renders 27 leads including the newly submitted TestUser.
critical_code_review_comments: WhatsAppChatButton: `armIdle` returns null when watchInactivity is false, but its useEffect early-returns in that case too — logic is correct but slightly redundant.
ShareCardModal `spaced()` helper takes a `px` arg that is unused; harmless dead param.
ShareCardModal useEffect deps include `visaLabel` which is derived from `visaType` + `t` — redundant but not buggy.
REACT_APP_SUPPORT_WHATSAPP is a placeholder (+61400000000). Before production launch this must be swapped for the real support number; document this in deployment checklist.
test_credentials: admin@aussieback.com / Admin@123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md not read — used from task brief).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 lead 'TestUser' via full estimator flow with test_iter3@example.com / +61412345678 / balance $5000 / working_holiday visa.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Iteration 3 features (share card modal + WhatsApp float/nudge) are working correctly on the public preview URL. Note: waiting 20s for the inactivity bubble to appear requires that no mousemove/keydown/scroll/touchstart occur — Playwright naturally stays idle so `page.wait_for_selector` with a >20s timeout works. Backend slowapi rate limit is 5/hr/IP; restart backend before running submission flow tests.
